manifest.name: Home Assistant
manifest.description: Your Home Assistant entities as widgets: switches, lights, sensors, climate, scenes. Live over the HA websocket. Also publishes orbis itself to HA over MQTT (next event, open tasks, focus switch).
widget.toggle.name: Switch / light
widget.toggle.description: One entity with its state and a big toggle. Lights get brightness.
widget.sensor.name: Sensor
widget.sensor.description: A value with unit, plus a small history sparkline.
widget.climate.name: Climate
widget.climate.description: Current and target temperature with +/- and mode.
widget.scenes.name: Scenes & scripts
widget.scenes.description: Buttons that activate scenes or run scripts.
widget.group.name: Entity list
widget.group.description: Several entities as compact rows with toggles and values.
page.entities.name: Home Assistant
notReady.notSetupHint: modules → home assistant → settings: url + token.
page.entities.title: home assistant
page.entities.copyHint: click an id to copy it into a widget config
settings.urlHint: as the hub reaches it, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123 or http://192.168.1.10:8123
settings.tokenHint: ha → click your name bottom left → security → long-lived access tokens → create
settings.info: the hub keeps one websocket to ha open and mirrors entity states; widgets update live. the token is stored on the hub only.
status.needsSetup: enter your home assistant url and a long-lived access token
error.notConfigured: home assistant is not set up yet: enter url and token in the module settings
error.badUrl: "{url}" is not a valid home assistant url – use http://host:8123 or https://…
error.timeout: home assistant did not answer in time
error.haError: home assistant answered with an error: {message}
